faqEntries.heading: How do I get my first Blaster?
faqEntries.content: Craft an Empty Blaster in the Blaster Terminal using a Blaster Claw, Blaster Handle and a Redstone Block. Once crafted, insert a filled Energy Jar to activate your Blaster's unique abilities.

faqEntries.heading: How do I get my first Energy Cube?
faqEntries.content: Find a Sulfur Cave biome and locate a vanilla Sulfur Cube. Energize it using Raw Copper, Copper Ingot, Raw Iron or Iron Ingot. Once energized, you have 10 seconds to capture it with an Empty Energy Jar. Your Energy Jar is ready for the Blaster!

faqEntries.heading: What are Energy Cubes?
faqEntries.content:
Energy Cubes determine your Blaster's abilities. 
Each cube grants different attacks and effects.

faqEntries.heading: Why did my Fusion fail?
faqEntries.content:
Only specific Energy Cube combinations produce Epic Energy Cubes. 
Invalid combinations will fail.

faqEntries.heading: Do all Blasters work differently?
faqEntries.content: Yes. Every Blaster features unique mechanics, attacks, particles and special abilities.

faqEntries.heading: Can I use multiple Blasters?
faqEntries.content: Absolutely. Collect and switch between different Blasters whenever you like.

howToEntries.content: The Sulfur Blaster Add-On lets you create powerful Blasters using Energy Cubes. Each Energy Cube gives your Blaster unique attacks and abilities.

howToEntries.heading: 1. Find a Sulfur Cube
howToEntries.content: Explore a Sulfur Cave biome and find a vanilla Sulfur Cube.

howToEntries.heading: 2. Get your Energy Cube
howToEntries.content: Energize the Sulfur Cube using Raw Copper, Copper Ingot, Raw Iron or Iron Ingot. You have 10 seconds to capture it with an Empty Energy Jar.

howToEntries.heading: 3. Craft an Empty Blaster
howToEntries.content: Use the Blaster Terminal to craft an Empty Blaster with a Blaster Claw, Blaster Handle and a Redstone Block. Insert the filled Energy Jar into the Empty Blaster. The Energy Cube inside determines your Blaster's attacks and abilities.

howToEntries.heading: 4. Upgrade with the Fusioner
howToEntries.content: Craft an Energy Fusioner to combine compatible Energy Jars into powerful Epic Energy Jars. Only specific combinations will succeed.

howToEntries.heading: 5. Experiment
howToEntries.content: Collect different Energy Cubes, craft new Blasters and discover unique attacks, useful tools and new combat strategies.
